title: Is this you?
body: We found profiles in the Groscove casting with a name similar to yours. If one of them is you, request your profile: the agency checks and grants access, and you get in with everything already there.
none: No profile found with that name.
emailMatches: The casting e-mail matches your account
notMe: None of them: create my Hero
searchAgain: Look for my profile in the casting
pendingBody: {agency} received your request for the profile {talent}. As soon as they confirm it's you, access is granted and you get a notice.
rejected: The agency did not confirm the profile {talent}. If it was a mistake, talk to them; or create your Hero below.
